What you can do:
Keep checking the tracking link for updates.
Allow a few business days for the carrier to process the first scan.
If there’s still no movement after about 7–10 business days, it may indicate a processing delay and further review may be needed.

How do I find my tracking link?
• Just now
Seen • Just now
You’ll receive your tracking link in a shipping confirmation email once your order ships. That email is sent to the same email address used at checkout and includes the carrier and tracking number.
To find it:
Check your inbox for the shipping confirmation email.
Also look in Spam, Junk, or Promotions folders in case it was filtered there.
Once you have the tracking number, you can enter it directly on the carrier’s website (such as UPS or USPS) to view the latest shipment updates.
If you haven’t received that email yet, it usually means the order hasn’t shipped yet and tracking will appear once it does.
